privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
Draft text: it must be reviewed before the app is published.

What we store: your name, email, a hashed password, an optional profile photo, your friends and groups, and the bills you split (items, amounts and participants).

Why: only to run the app: signing in, splitting bills with the people you choose, and showing your history.

Receipt photos you scan are sent to our server and to a text-recognition service to read the items. We do not keep the photo after the items are read.

Who sees your data: people you add as friends or share a bill with see your name, photo and that bill. We do not sell your data and show no ads.

Your control: in Settings you can change your name, email, password and photo, export your data and delete your account.

Questions: write to the address in “About the app”.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
Draft text: it must be reviewed before the app is published.

Splitter helps you split a bill with friends. The amounts it shows are calculated from the items you confirm; please check them before you pay.

You are responsible for your account and password. Do not share them.

Do not use the app to harass other people or to break the law. We may remove accounts that do.

The app is provided “as is”, without guarantees. Receipt recognition can make mistakes: always review the items.

You can delete your account at any time in Settings.
